panels.description: The public record identifies the supply as Caldera House inventory. Keep the source field unobstructed.
In a storage yard, Caldera-marked purifier crates sit sealed behind a barrier; a label states HOUSE INVENTORY — NOT CONNECTED. Leave upper space for lettering.
Tomas compares the crate identifier with a physical Keel gauge that remains nearly dry. Keep his hands, identifier and gauge in one readable comparison; leave upper space for the sound effect.
Tomas pushes the allocation sheet back. The Keel representatives mark it CHALLENGED; approval visibly stops. Leave upper-left for his line.
